name: Spirit Rock
summary: Above the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Spirit Rock draws Horde initiates to commune with the elements. A winding trail called the Hidden Path leads to this sacred crag.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of the Elements
sections.body: Spirit Rock overlooks the red canyon where young Horde warriors and scouts train. The Hidden Path winds up the rocky ridgeline to this quiet altar. Aspiring shaman climb to the outcrop and drink sapta, a traditional brew that opens their senses beyond the physical world. They listen for the earth's rumblings and whispers.

faq.q: What is Spirit Rock used for?
faq.answer: Horde shaman initiates use Spirit Rock for communion with the spirits of the earth. Novices drink Earth Sapta there to gain the spiritual vision needed to reach them.

faq.q: How do you reach Spirit Rock?
aliases: how to get to spirit rock
faq.answer: You can reach Spirit Rock by climbing the Hidden Path from the Valley of Trials in southwestern Durotar. The narrow trail winds from the canyon floor into the cliffs above.
Sapta is a ceremonial elemental brew prepared by shaman trainers. Drinking it changes a seeker's perception, revealing elemental manifestations hidden from ordinary senses.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll shaman, you climb the Hidden Path to Spirit Rock and drink Earth Sapta. There you begin your bond with the spirits of stone and soil.
